"sources":[
"pg: The COMMAND should only be written when STATUS.READY is asserted (Initializing/Specifying the Segments)",
"pg: Software can poll the STATUS.READY field to determine when it is safe to insert another segment descriptor",
"pg: The SPI_HOST has room to queue up exactly one additional segment descriptor in the Command Clock Domain Crossing; once a second descriptor is submitted, software must wait for the state machine to finish",
"th: Writing a segment description to COMMAND when STATUS.READY is low will trigger an error condition (ERROR_STATUS.CMDBUSY) and halt the IP until cleared",
"reg: STATUS.CMDQD (bits 19:16) command queue depth; STATUS.ACTIVE (bit 30) segment processing; STATUS.TXQD (bits 7:0) unsent TX words; STATUS.READY (bit 31)",
"reg: COMMAND fields: CSAAT bit0, SPEED bits2:1, DIRECTION bits4:3 (2=TxOnly), LEN bits24:5; value 0x00000102 = TxOnly/Standard/1 byte/CSAAT=0 for segment 1",
"pg: For multi-segment transactions, assert COMMAND.CSAAT for all but the last command segment",
"pg: 不使用中断场景下按 Interrupt configuration 复位默认 EVENT_ENABLE 全 0,全程可保持关闭 (reg: EVENT_ENABLE reset default 0x0)",
"pg (Exception Handling): 写 COMMAND 时 READY=0 触发 CMDBUSY 错误,IP 挂起直到 ERROR_STATUS 对应位被清除;本场景 READY 永不恢复,预算内 20 次 READY polling 均为低,构成充分证据:仅第 1 个 segment 被提交,第 2、3 个 segment 因 STATUS.READY 恒为 0 无法安全写入,宣告 3 个 segment 未全部发送完成"
]}
